description: ML learner with prior background wants conceptual understanding of a specific mechanism.

conversation.content: I've built a few CNNs and understand backprop pretty well. What I don't get is attention — specifically why transformers scaled so much better than RNNs. I want intuition, not a full math derivation. I can spend a weekend, around 10 hours. Visual explanations help a lot.

expected_goal.sub_goal: intuition for attention mechanisms and why transformers outperformed RNNs
